development_scope.note: Historical labels in this corpus are already development-consumed elsewhere in football3; this is diagnostic development evidence only, never fresh confirmation.

single_frozen_candidate.strong_weak_regime_rule: If max baseline 1X2 probability is strictly greater than 0.5, preserve baseline Top1 exactly. 0.5 is the canonical majority boundary, not a fitted threshold.
single_frozen_candidate.balanced_regime_rule: If max baseline 1X2 probability is <= 0.5, compute for each H/D/A region its macro mass P_k and micro peak M_k=max score-cell probability inside that outcome region; decision evidence G_k=sqrt(P_k*M_k). Choose argmax G_k.
single_frozen_candidate.draw_mechanism: Draw can become Top1 only through the same balanced-regime macro-micro evidence rule; there is no draw bonus, draw threshold, label-conditioned rule, or season exception.
single_frozen_candidate.tie_break: Highest G_k; exact G tie -> highest baseline P_k; exact remaining tie -> H then D then A deterministic index order.
single_frozen_candidate.probability_reporting: Keep Frozen V3.1.1 1X2 probabilities and joint matrix unchanged. Candidate changes only the discrete Top1 decision label.
single_frozen_candidate.rationale_frozen_before_score: State78 showed availability can improve proper scores but H/A probability tilts are not a stable Top1 flip mechanism and never create Draw Top1. This candidate therefore leaves calibrated probabilities untouched, protects majority/strong-favorite cases, and uses existing joint-score topology only in non-majority matches to test whether concentrated score-shape evidence can improve the discrete 3-class decision, including Draw.

interpretation_rule: PASS or FAIL is post-view development evidence only. No production promotion is authorized. Any change to majority boundary, geometric-mean formula, tie-break, regime logic, draw handling, or any additional feature is a new experiment and must be frozen before another outcome score.
